title: HoReCa
description: Hotels, restaurants, laundries and other hospitality venues use ozonation to create a comfortable environment, eliminate odors and maintain high hygiene standards.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.content:
Hotel room ozonation is a modern method for quick disinfection and odor removal. Ozone effectively destroys bacteria, viruses, mold, fungi and parasitic protozoa on all surfaces.

An air ozonator allows full treatment of a room after cleaning when guests change. Typically 30–60 minutes of treatment is enough. The gas penetrates all crevices and corners, disinfecting textiles, furniture and décor.

After treatment, ozone decomposes to oxygen without toxic byproducts. The air feels "fresh" without air fresheners or masking agents. Complete removal of tobacco, sweat, musty and damp odors.

Treatment does not require staff after the ozonator is switched on. Modern units have weekly timers for automation.

intro.p1: Hotel business is primarily about guest impressions. The smell of a smoked room, mustiness, foreign odors can ruin the impression of even the most luxurious hotel. Ozonation solves this problem radically — not masking odors, but destroying them at the molecular level.
intro.p2: In addition to eliminating odors, ozone disinfects all room surfaces: mattresses, pillows, curtains, carpets, upholstered furniture. The gas penetrates the material structure, destroying bacteria, viruses, dust mites and mold spores.

automation.title: Automation:
automation.text: Modern ozonators are equipped with weekly timers. Treatment can start automatically after room cleaning, without staff involvement.

problems.title: Problems solved by ozonation
items: Tobacco and hookah odor — complete removal, not masking
Mustiness and dampness — especially relevant for rooms without natural ventilation
Sweat and perfume odors from previous guests
Bacteria and viruses on contact surfaces
Dust mites in textiles — allergy prevention

steps.title: Standard cleaning
steps.description: Room undergoes regular cleaning: changing linens, wiping surfaces, vacuuming.

steps.title: Ozonator installation
steps.description: Portable ozonator is placed at maximum height (on wardrobe, shelf). Windows and doors are closed.

steps.title: Ozonation
steps.description: Treatment starts. Standard mode: 30-60 minutes at 1 g/h per 25 m³ capacity.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: After treatment — 20-30 minutes ventilation. Ozone decomposes to oxygen, leaving a fresh feeling.

whatIsTreated.title: What is treated with ozone
whatIsTreated.intro: Ozone, being a gas, penetrates all places inaccessible to traditional cleaning:

items.title: Textiles
items.description: Mattresses, pillows, blankets, curtains, furniture upholstery, carpets

items.title: Furniture
items.description: Internal cavities of wardrobes, crevices, decorative elements, armrests

items.title: Ventilation
items.description: Air ducts, grilles, air conditioning system — source of odors and bacteria

items.title: Bathroom
items.description: Tiles, grout, plumbing — places where bacteria and mold accumulate

benefits.title: Benefits for hotels
items: Higher ratings on Booking, TripAdvisor — reviews about cleanliness and freshness
Reduced guest complaints about odors — especially in smoking rooms
Prevention of infection transmission between guests
Ability to quickly turn over rooms — treatment during time between check-out and check-in
Reduced costs for air fresheners and fragrances
Extended textile lifespan — odor removal without dry cleaning
benefits.highlight: Research shows: 87% of guests note "room freshness" as an important factor when evaluating a hotel. Ozonation creates a "just renovated" room feeling.

equipment.title: Equipment for hotels
equipment.intro: For hotels, portable ozonators are recommended, which staff move from room to room after cleaning. This is the optimal solution in terms of price/effectiveness ratio.
tableData: Ozonator fleet + stationary units in common areas

benefits: Complete removal of tobacco and sweat odors
